items.translation: TransactionTimedOutException - 如果期限已经到达

items.source:
Features rollback-only support for participating transactions.
Can expire after a certain number of seconds or milliseconds
in order to determine a transactional timeout.
items.translation: 支持参与式事务的仅回滚功能。可在特定秒数或毫秒数后过期，以确定事务超时时间。

items.source:
Only really intended to be called after custom rollback steps which
keep the original resource in action, for example, in case of a savepoint.
items.translation: 仅应在自定义回滚步骤之后调用，这些步骤会保持原始资源处于活动状态，例如在保存点的情况下。

items.source:
Return the time to live for this object in seconds.
Rounds up eagerly, for example, 9.00001 still to 10.
items.translation: 返回此对象的生存时间（以秒为单位）。会向上取整，例如，9.00001 仍为 10。

items.source:
Increase the reference count by one because the holder has been requested
(i.e. someone requested the resource held by it).
items.translation: 增加引用计数一，因为持有者已被请求（即有人请求了其持有的资源）。

items.source:
Decrease the reference count by one because the holder has been released
(i.e. someone released the resource held by it).
items.translation: 将引用计数减一，因为持有者已被释放（即有人释放了它所持有的资源）。
